fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-05-19, around 22:25, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 9,900 was withdrawn, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-19. Kumaran Prakash reported the matter orally at Chennai South PS; the contact number given was 9000000476. A witness, Kishore Selvam, reachable on 9000000323, was mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Kishore Babu, using the number 9000000076. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00064, as the mobile number 9000000076 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, night, shopping complex, screenshot, mobile number, suspect, witness
